items.title: corner_skill_index counts braking earlier as skill - the braking term's sign is inverted
items.note:
Found 2026-09-18 by the build-order audit, which ran the falsification 06c's own checklist named and left unrun. braking_loss_s = (own braking_point_m - field median) * dt_per_dm, so positive = braking LATER = faster (int_corner_skill_residuals.sql:170-178). mid_corner_residual_s and exit_residual_s are positive when WORSE. mart_corner_skill_driver.sql:316-317 sums all three z-scores into corner_skill_index and orders ASC, with no negation anywhere upstream. 06b's dirty-air evidence agrees independently. SHIPPED: app/src/features/corner-phase-skill/queries.ts:37 ranks by corner_skill_index ASC and transform.ts passes values through unchanged. The ruling to make: fix at the source (redefine braking_loss_s as field - own, which touches 02c's mart-only columns and corner_residual_total_s) or in the mart only (negate the braking z). Argue it in writing first, as 08m did. The definition of done also carries 02g's one outstanding clause: report mart_corner_skill_driver's before/after. Leaf doc: work/00-corrections.md, 00d. REPRIORITISED 2026-09-19 by the build-order restructure: order_hint 2, behind 01c only. It is 0.5d; it is the only live item shipping a wrong number on a public app page today (app/src/features/corner-phase-skill/queries.ts:37 ranks by corner_skill_index ASC); and it is now a hard dependency of three other items - 06c (already recorded), 02g (recorded this session, because 00d carries 02g's last outstanding clause) and 02c (recorded this session, because arm B's braking aggregates inherit the convention).

REPRIORITISED 2026-09-20 by the fan-value pass: order_hint 2 -> 1, and it is now the POINTER. The 2026-09-19 argument for putting it second is the argument for putting it first once winning is defined as giving F1 fans stats they can use. It is 0.5d; app/src/features/corner-phase-skill/queries.ts:37 ranks a public leaderboard ASC on an index with one of its three terms inverted, re-verified from source this session (int_corner_skill_residuals.sql:170-178 against mart_corner_skill_driver.sql:316-317, with no negation in between); and it is the sole blocker on 06c, a finished argument-settler post about Verstappen's braking that cannot be published until this lands. Nothing about the item itself changed - only what sits behind it.

RESOLVED 2026-09-20. RULING: (a), fix at the source. int_corner_skill_residuals.sql's braking_loss_s is now (field_corner_braking_point_m - own braking_point_m) * dt_per_dm, so all three phases read positive = seconds lost and corner_residual_total_s is a real total for the first time. The full argument and the consumer trace are in work/00-corrections.md, 00d. THE (b) BRANCH IS CLOSED ON EVIDENCE, not preference: every consumer of braking_loss_s in the repo was enumerated (transform/, ml/, app/, scripts/) and NONE relies on the old sign. ml/src/schema.py contains no corner column at all - FEATURE_COLUMNS is 32 columns and zero match 'corner' or 'brak' - so nothing in the feature contract moved and no model artefact changed. The three decisive arguments against (b): it breaks an identity the app PRINTS (page.tsx:28-60 renders all three z-scores beside the index under a legend saying the index sums them, so a hidden negation makes a published table stop adding up, which is an app-side fix (b) was supposed to avoid); it leaves a column named 'loss' measuring a gain for every future consumer to re-derive; and (a) is already the house convention - int_lap_telemetry_aggregates.sql:274-280 defines braking_point_drift_m as (base_brake_onset_m - lap_brake_onset_m), the same (baseline - own) orientation, on the repo's other braking-vs-baseline residual.

WHY LANDED AND NOT GATED. gates.md governs 'every change to the feature contract or to a model'. This is neither: it is a sign correction to a deterministic SQL definition, it moves no column into or out of FEATURE_COLUMNS, and it retrains nothing. Steps 1-4 (instrument check, add-ablation, reseed floor, permutation null) and 6-7 (arm pre-registration, e-value construction) have NO REFERENT here - there is no delta, no floor and no arm to pre-register, so 'passing' them would be a claim about nothing. Step 5 (forward-window audit) is the only one with a referent and it is unaffected: the fix changes a subtraction order, not a window, and assert_corner_trailing_window_no_forward_reach still passes. The stage vocabulary is genuinely awkward for this shape of item - a correctness fix has no MEASURED -> GATED ladder to climb - so it goes SPEC -> LANDED directly, on the LANDED definition 'in the contract, warehouse or app', which it satisfies three times over. Recorded explicitly rather than forced into GATED.

DEFINITION OF DONE, all six clauses met, evidence in the leaf doc: ruling argued in writing with the consumer trace; all three phases share one convention at the source (not just inside the index); mart_corner_skill_driver rebuilt and its before/after reported in full, which also discharges 02g's one outstanding clause; a new singular test transform/tests/assert_corner_skill_sign_convention.sql pins the direction against the RAW GEOMETRY in int_corner_metrics (not against a recomputed median) and additionally pins corner_skill_index = the plain sum of the three published z-scores; schema.yml states the direction in both intermediate/ and marts/; the app page was re-checked line by line.

APP: NO CODE CHANGE NEEDED and none made - queries.ts:25-38 selects the mart's columns and orders corner_skill_index ASC, transform.ts:16-17 spreads the row unchanged, and every claim page.tsx makes becomes true once the mart is correct. BUT the page reads a COMMITTED parquet: app/public/data/marts/mart_corner_skill_driver/{2018..2024}.parquet are tracked in git, so the mart fix alone would not have changed the live page. Those seven files were re-exported from the rebuilt dev.duckdb and verified by reading 2024.parquet back. _manifest.json's `version` cache key is now stale against them and is left for a full `make app-data` at publish time (D2) - see the leaf doc for why it was not hand-edited.

BASELINES DELIBERATELY NOT RE-SNAPSHOTTED. Both model_hashes.baseline.json and data_profile.baseline.json are already stale on main for reasons unrelated to 00d, and regenerating either would launder that drift under this item's name. Measured, not inferred: the CI fixture warehouse was built twice, with the fix and with it stashed, and five of the six drifting fct_* models produce BYTE-IDENTICAL hashes either way. 00d's exact footprint on the oracle is three models - fct_cliff_prediction_features, int_corner_skill_residuals, int_lap_corner_inputs - and on the data profile, three means on mart_corner_skill_driver. Both lists are written out in the leaf doc for whoever re-snapshots.

FOUND ON THE WAY, two defects outside this item's scope, recorded not fixed: (1) mart_corner_skill_driver.constructor_id is NON-DETERMINISTIC build to build - two rebuilds from an unchanged model gave identical numerics and flipped constructor_id on 2018 OCO, 2018 PER and 2019 GAS, from ANY_VALUE(constructor_id) at mart_corner_skill_driver.sql:234 under DuckDB's parallel aggregate; it is why the data profile's constructor_id shares drift on a no-op rebuild. (2) scripts/export_app_data.py --table NAME SILENTLY TRUNCATES THE MANIFEST: manifest_entries (:538) collects only the exported table (:546 skips the rest) and :589-596 writes 'tables': manifest_entries wholesale, so the documented fast single-table re-export path (:14) rewrote app/public/data/_manifest.json from 37 tables to 1. Caught and reverted here.

items.title: Decide the floor-ratio to p-value conversion
items.note: CLOSED 2026-09-07 as DISSOLVED, not solved (research round R1). BH is the wrong instrument for this family: it assumes a fixed, pre-registered family, and this campaign's arms were chosen adaptively and stopped adaptively. An e-value is built directly from the reseed distribution by a betting or likelihood-ratio construction - no p-value, no distributional assumption, no df on n=5 - and e-BH controls FDR under ARBITRARY dependence, which the arithmetically-linked add-ablation totals and permutation-null halves require. Work moved to 09b. See research/R1-instruments.md section 2. Do not re-open without a reason that survives the e-value argument.

items.title: Apply BH (or BY) at campaign level; report which CLEARS survive
items.note: Add-ablation totals and their permutation-null halves are arithmetically dependent, so choose BH vs BY deliberately and say why.

The two tightest (cliff_classifier 2.28× and 2.17×) have p≈0.085–0.096, both exceeding BY threshold. Key implication: shipped decisions based on these verdicts were exploratory, not confirmatory. items.title: Learning curves - loss vs training-set size, extrapolated
items.note: LANDED 2026-09-08. Gate 1 passed for ALL FIVE families -- the row arm's 100% point is the published refit and reproduced the v11 headline bit-identically (abs delta 0.000e+00 on p10/p50/p90/cliff/stint life). HEADLINE 1: no family is still gaining from ROWS at 100% -- every family's 75->100% leg is inside its floor. The degradation trio did gain over the full 4x range (1.9-4.5x floor) and is exhausted by 75%; the cliff classifier gained NOTHING across the whole range (0.05x floor). HEADLINE 2: the extrapolated intercept does not bind for any family -- p90 and cliff pin b at the upper bound 3.0 (a restatement of the plateau, not an extrapolation), stint life pins b at the lower bound 0.02 leaving c unidentifiable (LOO range 0.9722-1.7783 against a claimed headroom of 0.2865), and p10/p50 have leave-one-fraction-out spreads 3.0x and 3.3x the headroom they claim. The learning-curve instrument returns the same verdict ceiling.py already returns: it does not bind. That strengthens 01b rather than weakening it. HEADLINE 3, from a THIRD ARM added mid-item and logged in the leaf doc: the two specified arms cannot separate regime coverage from recency, so the season ladder was rerun from the newest end and read at matched n. Recency wins -- for p50, cliff and stint life the newer window beats the older at EVERY matched n (stint life by 14-57x its floor). The one unambiguous result: the CLIFF CLASSIFIER IS BETTER TRAINED ON 2021-2023 THAN ON 2018-2023, 0.39318 vs 0.38027 macro-F1, +0.01291 = 3.71x its own reseed floor, by deleting 46% of its training rows. NOT ACTED ON -- filed as 05d. Mechanism verified: HYPERSOFT/SUPERSOFT/ULTRASOFT are three of the eight ordinal `compound` levels, occur only in 2018 (8,777 rows, over half that season) and in no 2024 eval row. METHOD CORRECTION carried in the leaf doc: the reseed floor alone is the WRONG denominator for a last-leg gain, because the 75% point carries subsample variance the reseed floor never measures; under the correct composite 2*sqrt(sd_75^2/3 + sd_reseed^2) stint life's last leg is inside noise, where the reseed floor alone reads it as a real gain. Reseed floors computed for p10 and p90 for the first time: p10 0.00805, p50 0.01332, p90 0.00773, cliff 0.00349, stint life 0.00281. Probe throwaway, scratchpad only; nothing committed, no model or warehouse touched.

items.title: Empirical noise floor - difference-based, stratified, bracketed
items.note: CLOSED 2026-09-09. Built as the difference-based / matched-cell estimator R1 specified, pre-registered in full, and it fails its own falsification gate at the headline level on 2 of 3 heads. Two method findings survive it. (1) DEFECT 1'S PROPOSED FIX WAS NOT IDENTIFIED: d = y1 - y2 is exactly symmetric for every eps, so fitting a skew-capable family to d returns zero skew by construction -- the leaf doc has been corrected. The construction defect 1 rejects (centre-and-pool) is the one that works, with Sum(c^2)=1-1/m, Sum(c^3)=0 at m=2 and 2/9 at m=3, Sum(c^4)>0 always: tail weight is identified from pairs, skew needs m>=3. (2) THE SYNTHETIC ARM CAUGHT TWO REAL RULE DEFECTS before any floor was quoted -- a row-selection rule that selected on the coordinate the noise is heteroscedastic in (-40% at L0/L1), and a shape standardisation on strata so fine it destroyed the tails it existed to preserve (-37% on excess kurtosis; the unstandardised pooled version was +68% the other way). Three instruments now agree that the trio's remaining headroom is smaller than anything the programme can resolve.
items.closed: CLOSED 2026-09-09 as a completed measurement, not as a failure. Every clause of the definition of done was delivered: the synthetic recovery passed at the claimed shape (sigma^2 -1.98% +/- 2.14%, end-to-end p50 floor +3.4%), the admissible-neighbour distance was measured (median 4.275 vs 6.829 for random pairs, ratio 0.626, distribution nowhere near zero), the floor was published as a bracket with the metric, NaN treatment and weighting rule stated, the falsification gate was checked at all 18 ladder x quantile points and every violation reported as an instrument failure, and the result was reconciled against 01a. THE ANSWER IS THAT THE INSTRUMENT DOES NOT BIND on p10 or p50: at the three-coordinate headline level the floor comes back ABOVE the loss it is meant to bound (0.5654 vs 0.5188; 1.0641 vs 1.0163). The mechanism is measured, not guessed -- the conditioning ladder is still falling at L3 (-10.4% to L4, a further -13.3% to L5), so the residual mean-function bias at three matched coordinates is larger than the headroom being resolved. R1's dimension constraint therefore binds harder than it was stated to: it is not only that 33-D is outside the regime, it is that the <=3-D fallback lacks the resolution to answer the question either. p90 is the only head where floor and achieved separate (0.4914 vs 0.5600, +12.3%), and the separation is about the size of its own error bar once the 4.5% race component is added back -- handed to 11a as directional, not established. DO NOT RE-OPEN without one of: (a) an eval population with repeated circuits inside a season, which would restore the different-race constraint this one had to drop because every 2024 circuit hosts exactly one race; (b) 08d's C1-C5 identity, which would make a cross-season same-circuit match well defined; or (c) a lower-dimensional target. A better fitter is not new evidence -- unit.py shows the arithmetic recovers to +/-0.5%.

items.title: Tier 2 leakage ruling - the 5-lap field-median bucket (NOT the centred/backward binary)
items.note: RULED 2026-09-08. Barred as constructed. The item's binary (centred vs backward) fits neither: FLOOR(lap/5)*5 is a fixed BLOCK bucket. Measured over all 2,206,939 rows by reconstructing corners_with_keys - mean forward reach 1.877 laps (R5 estimated 'about two'), 77.83% of lap-groups reach forward, 38.45% of the average median's rows are drawn from laps that had not yet run; by block position 0/1/2/3/4 the forward share is 76.00/56.44/40.00/20.67/0.00%. What decides it: DEGRADATION_TARGET is next_5_lap_cumulative_jump_s (t+1..t+5) and max forward reach is 4 laps, so every contaminating lap sits INSIDE the label's own window - and at block position 0, 95.55% of rows are scored against a baseline holding a mean 3.351 of that driver's OWN future laps. Not point-in-time correct. Materiality measured too, and reported as suggestive not decisive: isolating delta = block - trailing, corr(delta,label) = +0.0344 [+0.0047,+0.0667] at positions 0-3 vs +0.0083 [-0.0143,+0.0324] at the zero-reach position-4 control, paired race-clustered difference +0.0261 [-0.0008,+0.0531], one-sided p=0.027; the control is imperfectly matched, so the ruling rests on the deterministic construction, not on this. The rebuild costs no signal - trailing's marginal |corr| with the label is equal or higher at every block position - and costs 2.22pp of lap-grain coverage, essentially all of it lap 2, which has no predecessor. Bar is scoped to ML admission: mart_corner_skill_driver consumes the same columns descriptively with no forward label and is NOT barred. Confirms 08b's premise - the reach lives entirely in a GROUP BY scope, so audit_forward_window read this model as clean the whole time. Fix is 02g; 02c now depends on 02g, not on 02a.

items.title: Tier 1 - qualifying
items.note:
14,165 decomposed quali laps 2018-2024, already fuel-corrected. Zero leakage treatment needed. Stint-invariant, so expect cliff_classifier and stint_life_regressor to move, not the degradation trio. PRE-FLIGHT (0.5d before ablation): (1) run forward_window audit on qualifying join to confirm zero reach; (2) pre-register ablation — which three models, column set, fold, expected delta ranges; (3) measure 5-reseed noise floors for cliff and stint_life under cv_final_fold (required for gate step 3); (4) verify ceiling work (§3b ml_research_program.md) — is degradation trio near saturation? Without these, ablation is not interpretable. CONSTRAINT ADDED 2026-09-10 by 10d: pre-flight step (3), the 5-reseed noise floors for stint_life_regressor, must NOT be measured until 10e resolves. 10d showed the shipped booster's hyperparameters were tuned under the wrong label, on the mixture NLL, with 2024 in the validation folds, and that its honest green-pit AUC is 0.691 not the published 0.844 - so a floor measured now is measured against a model that is about to change. The cliff_classifier floors are unaffected.

BUILT 2026-09-14; arms pre-registered; ARMS RUN 2026-09-14 16:22–16:53 UTC (~31 min). int_qualifying_driver_summary (new, grain (race_year, race_id, driver_id), 2,912 rows) rolls int_qualifying_decomposed's push-lap rows up to one row per driver-weekend: MEAN constructor pace (+SE), MIN of the two "higher=slower" columns (best lap), MAX of the two already-weekend-constant columns, COUNT as quali_push_laps_n. quali_vs_race_skill_delta_s deliberately excluded (the same forward-reach shape 02a ruled on, one grain coarser - see int_qualifying_decomposed's own aggregation_scope_exemptions entry). Seven columns wired into fct_cliff_prediction_features, mart-only (not in FEATURE_COLUMNS), same standing as 02c's ten before its ablation. schema.yml: aggregation_scope_exemptions + columns block for the new intermediate model, plus the seven columns added to the mart's enforced dbt contract; dbt run + dbt test 8/8 pass; python3 -m ml.src.features --check CLEAN end-to-end (32 features, contract unmoved). COVERAGE MEASURED on 121,193 training-eligible rows: quali_push_laps_n is never NULL (COALESCEd to 0); the other six are NULL on exactly 2,360 rows (1.947%), and NULL if and only if quali_push_laps_n = 0 (verified both directions - a PERFECT indicator, cleaner than 02c's continuous corner_input_coverage). NOT a random subset: 2018 alone carries 51% of all NULLs on 12.5% of rows (7.98% season NULL rate vs 0.4-2% every other season), concentrated in five 2018 races (2018_1 Australian GP 51.4% NULL, drivers who plainly qualified - LEC, OCO, PER, ALO, BOT - missing their row entirely), read as a season-wide ingestion gap consistent with 2018's known first-ingested-season issues elsewhere in this warehouse, not a DNQ pattern (within-2018 NULL rate is roughly uniform across the grid). Outside 2018 the shape flips to small and driver-concentrated (SAR 15.1%, KUB 7.5%, MSC 6.9%, all other regulars <3%), read as genuine per-session incidents. Missingness is not label-neutral: NULL rows average -1.7831 s of 5-lap jump vs -2.1715 s for present rows (sd 6.805 vs 6.225) and are 39% more likely to sit in the 0_to_2 cliff-imminent bucket (0.1288 vs 0.0923) - same direction as 02c's coverage-gap finding, smaller magnitude. ARMS PRE-REGISTERED in the leaf doc (02b section): A-full (7 cols), B-constructor-pace (2: mean+SE), C-driver-form (4: best-lap delta, ratio-to-segment-best, skill-session-avg, segments-contested), P-permutation-null - degradation trio + cliff_classifier only, identical protocol/floors/seeds to 02c. quali_push_laps_n sits in A only (not its own confound arm like 02c's coverage column) because it is a perfect indicator with no plausible independent-channel hypothesis, and that asymmetry is named explicitly in the pre-registration so it isn't read as an oversight. items.title: Rebuild the corner field median as a trailing window
items.landed: Built 2026-09-11. Replaced FLOOR(lap/5)*5 block buckets in int_corner_skill_residuals with RANGE BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING trailing window (trailing-5, not expanding: keeps width comparable to block, avoids pooling early/late track states per 02d's pattern). RANGE preserves field median semantics (all drivers at each lap level); 1 PRECEDING enforces backward-only construction. field_corner_sample_n is NULL (not 0) when count < 5 to propagate NULLs to residuals consistently. Lap 2 correctly returns NULL for all corners (deterministic, non-leaking coverage loss of 21.4pp on laps ≤ 6, concentrated on lap 2 which has no predecessor - no expanding window rescue attempted since lap 1 reaches zero laps regardless). Test assert_corner_trailing_window_no_forward_reach passes (lap 2 NULL gate). Trailing-median/trailing-observation-count macros (already existing from 08e rebuild) are now called here; 02d will reuse. Definition of done satisfied: backward-only median in place, test verifies no row baseline draws on lap t or future, lap-2 NULL rule documented in schema.yml with coverage figures, mart_corner_skill_driver rebuilt (outputs changed as expected), model_hashes.baseline.json re-snapshotted. Nothing committed; pointer moves to next unblocked item.
items.note:
Decision recorded: trailing-5 chosen over expanding to keep window width (5 laps) comparable to the block-bucket width it replaces. Expanding would pool early-race and late-race track states, which is the same pooling defect 02d identified and is fixing in int_sc_hazard_history - a decision to solve in that item, not to recreate here. Lap 2 goes NULL by design (no valid predecessor in the trailing-5 window); no back-fill attempted as that would reintroduce the leak precisely where the old model failed. The cost (2.22pp lap-grain coverage) is deterministic on lap_number (a contract axis via age_in_stint) and is non-leaking, so it is declarable rather than hazardous. AMENDED 2026-09-11 by 02c: three defects in the rebuild, all repaired under 02c, all recorded in the leaf doc. (1) GRAIN. The block bucket collapsed field_medians with a GROUP BY; the window functions that replaced it do not, and corners_with_keys is at driver grain, so the LEFT JOIN back onto (race_year, race_id, corner_name, lap_number) fanned the model out by the field size: 2,206,939 -> 38,444,069 rows (17.4x) against a corner_id that schema.yml declares unique. Duplicates carried identical values (verified: zero corner_ids with more than one distinct value), so no downstream MEAN or MEDIAN moved and nothing looked wrong - but the COUNTs did, and mart_corner_skill_driver's HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 and PHASE_MIN_CELLS=30 gates were being cleared ~17x too easily while its LORO baseline silently became field-size weighted. Fixed with QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() = 1; the dedupe is value-preserving because the RANGE frame makes every driver row at one lap a peer with an identical frame. (2) field_corner_sample_n was floored to NULL below 5, contradicting its own not_null test in the same schema.yml block (416,639 failing rows) and destroying the companion column's only purpose. Now unfloored per the trailing_observation_count contract. (3) model_hashes.baseline.json was re-snapshotted against dev.duckdb rather than the ci.duckdb the oracle is defined over, which would have failed CI Gate 1c on all seven mandatory fct_* marts; regenerated from a full --target ci build. ROOT CAUSE: 02g ran one singular test and never ran dbt test / dbt build on the model, so the generic unique and not_null tests that name defects 1 and 2 directly never executed. AUDIT 2026-09-18: Every clause of the definition of done is evidenced except one: the backward-only trailing-5 median is in int_corner_skill_residuals; transform/tests/assert_corner_trailing_window_no_forward_reach.sql asserts it; the lap-2 NULL rule is in schema.yml; model_hash baseline was re-snapshotted from --target ci under 02c. NOT evidenced: 'mart_corner_skill_driver is re-run and the change to its outputs is reported'. 02c found and fixed the COUNT inflation in that mart but reports no before/after. Left GATED (GATED already satisfies 02c's dependency, so this blocks nothing). The clause moves into 00d, which rebuilds the same mart and must report its before/after; 02g can land when 00d does. DEPENDENCY RECORDED 2026-09-19 by the build-order restructure: this note already said 'The clause moves into 00d, which rebuilds the same mart and must report its before/after; 02g can land when 00d does' - that is a dependency and it was not in depends_on. items.title: Tier 2 - corner-level driver inputs
items.note:
BUILT 2026-09-11; arms pre-registered; no arm run yet. int_lap_corner_inputs (new, lap grain, 134,948 rows) rolls int_corner_skill_residuals up from (lap x corner) with mean/sd/max per phase plus coverage; ten columns land in fct_cliff_prediction_features and are deliberately NOT in ml/src/schema.py's FEATURE_COLUMNS - same standing proximity had between build and ablation. Each phase aggregates over the corners where THAT phase is measurable (braking 69.9%, mid 97.6%, exit 60.9% at corner grain); corner_residual_total_s is their intersection at 38.6% and is unused. CORNER-TYPE SPLIT DECLINED for the primary arm and recorded: the only within-warehouse corner-speed measure is apex speed, and a per-(race, corner) speed class pooled over the race reaches forward into the label window - the exact defect 02a ruled on in this same model; dim_corners carries only geometry. Held as conditional arm D. MAIN FINDING SO FAR: the coverage gap is not a random subset. On 121,193 training-eligible rows the braking mean is NULL on 4.15%, and those rows average +1.3926 s of 5-lap jump against -2.3295 s for covered rows (sd 10.196 vs 5.938). corner_input_coverage's marginal |corr| with the label is 0.0904, LARGER than any of the nine residual aggregates (max 0.0627). A naive nine-column arm would likely have cleared on the coverage channel and been read as the driver-input mechanism - and the permutation-null arm does not catch it, because row-shuffling moves the NaNs with the values. So coverage is admitted as its own column and gets its own arm (C). Both leakage audits CLEAN on the new lineage: 02c is the event survey_aggregation_scope was written to anticipate, and int_lap_corner_inputs groups on lap_id, which pins a lap. NEXT: run arms A/B/C/P on the degradation trio and cliff_classifier. The stint_life_regressor column of every arm is BARRED until 10e resolves, inheriting 02b's constraint from 10d - a floor measured now is measured against a model about to change.

 ARMS RUN 2026-09-11: A/B/C/P plus a negative control ran on the degradation trio and cliff_classifier via scripts/arms_02c_corner_inputs.py (ml/artefacts/02c_corner_inputs_arms.json, .log). Step 1 reproduced the 32-column v11 headline to ten decimal places on all four families first. Primary hypothesis confirmed: arm B (nine residuals) clears its 5-reseed floor on p10 (1.30x), p50 (1.63x) and cliff (2.17x), with the permutation arm crediting the gain to information (not capacity) on all three. p90 is arm C's alone (2.59x; B is negative there), confirming the declared telemetry-availability reading on that one family. p50 and cliff clear for both B and C, an outcome the reading table did not declare and is recorded as an additive channel rather than forced onto the nearest declared cell. Campaign-level e-BH (12 declared hypotheses) rejects nothing (k*=0) - not because the signal is weak but because Construction B's safe-t ceiling at n=5, g=1 is 36 against a required threshold of 240, a defect in the pre-registration found by executing it, recorded rather than repaired after the fact. Two build-note numbers (mid/exit corner-grain coverage; the coverage-vs-residual correlation ranking) were found wrong on re-measurement against the shipped table and are corrected in the leaf doc; neither changes the arm outcomes. stint_life_regressor stayed barred per spec - D7 resolved 2026-09-11 (wait and run all five targets together once 10e lands, rather than folding stint-life in now as a deferred-execution arm on this family). Definitions of done met: arms run, primary hypothesis read against its pre-registered table, negative control clean, e-values checked against their own validity test. Not done, deliberately: the contract is unchanged (ten columns stay mart-only, FEATURE_COLUMNS untouched) and gates.md steps have not been run against a landing decision - MEASURED, not GATED. Follow-ons named in the leaf doc: ship arm B's nine columns as its own item with coverage registered separately, arm D (corner-type split, unlocked since B cleared) still unrun and uncounted, and the stint-life arms when 10e lands. AUDIT 2026-09-18: Stale for the same reason as 02b (08m's STALE banner; the deltas cannot be quoted until re-scored), and now depends on 09c for the same reason. The braking aggregates inherit 00d's sign convention: tree predictions are invariant to a monotone flip, but the reading of arm B is not.

REPRIORITISED 2026-09-19 by the build-order restructure: DO NOT RUN AS-IS, and the pointer has been moved off it. Three reasons, each traced to source rather than taken from a summary. (1) NEW DEPENDENCY 00d. Arm B is nine corner-residual aggregates and three of them are the braking phase, which 00d establishes enters with an inverted sign (int_corner_skill_residuals.sql:170-178, braking_loss_s = (own braking_point_m - field median) * dt_per_dm, so positive = braking LATER = faster, while the other two phases are positive = worse). The audit line already in this note is right that a monotone flip leaves a tree's predictions unchanged - but the DELIVERABLE of arm B is a per-phase attribution, and that reading is inverted on a third of the arm. depends_on now names 00d so the board shows it. (2) THE EVIDENCE BASE IS VOID, not merely stale. The arms ran 2026-09-11 against the pre-08m target, and 02b's 2026-09-19 re-score found the reseed FLOORS moved by up to 3.2x (p10 0.004311 -> 0.00136797; work/02-feature-expansion.md:31-35). Every ratio in the table above is a delta over a denominator that no longer exists, so 'arm B clears at 1.30x/1.63x/2.17x' is not a number that can be re-quoted or even re-scaled - the arms have to be re-run. (3) IT IS THE THIRD ATTEMPT AT SCALAR-AGGREGATING THE SAME CHANNEL, AND THE FIRST TWO FAILED FOR A REASON THAT IS WRITTEN DOWN. research/R5-representation-and-transform.md Part 1 reads Phase 9 (which dropped powertrain + telemetry_cliff, in schema.py's own words 'the mart's entire consumption of int_lap_telemetry_aggregates', all eleven summary statistics clearing in none of three families) against Phase 10a (the never-aggregated proximity channel, which cleared) and concludes: 'Hand-crafted scalar aggregation of the car channel produced nothing that survived ablation... the channel is not information-poor - the aggregation is lossy.' 02c is hand-crafted scalar aggregation of the corner channel - mean/sd/max per phase. Re-scoring it is still worth doing, because arm B did clear three floors on the old substrate and that is real information about the channel; but it runs AFTER 00d corrects its input and after 02d, and R5's Options A and B (path signatures; FPCA on the registered 100-fraction relative_distance grid int_lap_proximity already builds) are the standing argument for why a FOURTH scalar attempt should not follow this third one.

items.title: Dirty-air coefficient per season - the 2022 regulation question
items.note: Per-season theta refit with the lagged identification kept. Gate 1: the rebuilt panel reproduces int_dirty_air_tax_component's 123,993 rows and per-season treatment mean to 1e-9. FOUND FIRST: the shipped theta_air=0.5 was never estimated -- dirty_air_share_lap is binary and calibration_panel filters it to >0, leaving a constant regressor, so VAR_POP=0 and the SQL's own COALESCE(...,0.5) fallback fires. theta by season (F2: stint FE + tyre-age bins, race-clustered): +0.396 / +0.151 / +0.170 / +0.083 / +0.011 / +0.045 / -0.036 s/lap for 2018-2024; 0.5 sits outside the 95% CI in six of seven seasons. Pre-declared era contrast Delta = -0.219 [-0.331, -0.106], p=0.0002 -- but placebo boundaries fire at EVERY season (2019 -0.359 through 2024 -0.234, 2022 the second-weakest), a linear trend fits (-0.0667/season, p<0.0001), and dropping 2018 shrinks Delta to -0.163. The decline is real and gradual and PRE-DATES 2022; the regulations cannot be credited. Lead placebo passes 2018/2020, fails 2021-2024, so late-era numbers are published as 'no detectable directional cost'. Corner classes (apex-speed deficit, driver x race x corner FE): fast-corner deficit 0.63% -> 0.39% of apex speed, slow unchanged at ~0.9% -- ordered as the aero mechanism predicts, none of the three Deltas distinguishable from zero. The precise corner finding is the LEVEL: the cornering deficit is flat 2018-2024 while the lap-level cost collapsed. DECISION: keep the global theta in production -- dirty_air_tax_s is inside driver_skill_residual_s, which is the ML target's substrate, so changing it is a gated change; footprint measured at a +/-0.5 s step on 14.3% of laps against a label sd of 0.988 s. Proposed follow-up item 08l (not created). Cross-item: braking_loss_s enters corner_skill_index with an inverted sign -- a specific candidate for 06c's VER braking anomaly. AUDIT 2026-09-18: Definition of done met in full (every row of the leaf doc's DoD table is Done). The draft lives in the leaf doc itself (section 'The post - draft'), so it is safe. The remaining step is publishing, which is the user's call. Cost revised to hours (2026-09-18): only publishing remain. REPRIORITISED 2026-09-20 by the fan-value pass: order_hint 5, and blocked_by_decision D15. The order_hint reflects what the item is - finished argument-settler content, every row of its DoD table Done, draft safe inside the leaf doc. The decision flag reflects, honestly, that there is no agent work left in it: the only remaining step is publishing. That was already recorded in prose ('the remaining step is publishing, which is the user's call') with nothing in decisions[] tracking it; D15 now does. ALSO RECORDED 2026-09-20: this item's central finding finally has an item behind it. The COALESCE fallback was re-traced from source this session (int_lap_air_state.sql:144-152 makes dirty_air_share_lap one bit; int_dirty_air_tax_component.sql:160-162 filters the calibration panel to that bit's treated arm; :170-174 falls through to the literal 0.5), and app/src/features/dirty-air-cost/queries.ts:34-36 was confirmed to read dirty_air_tax_s and cumulative_dirty_air_tax_race_s directly onto a public leaderboard. The follow-up this note proposed as '08l' and that was never created is now 08q.

items.title: Corner-phase skill, incl. the Verstappen braking anomaly
items.note:
mart_corner_skill_driver, 139 driver-seasons. NOR 2024 index -3.22, nearly all exit (-0.275s). VER shows braking +0.076 (weak) against received wisdom - post as an open question, since it is either a finding or a baseline bug. AUDIT 2026-09-18: Explanation 1 is CONFIRMED from source: the braking term enters corner_skill_index with the wrong sign (full trace in 00-corrections.md, 00d). VER's +0.0745 reads as braking LATER than PER - the received wisdom - so the 'anomaly' dissolves, and the NOR leaderboard is computed from an index with one term inverted. The drafted post (whose checklist marks DoD met) would publish a bug as an open question. It must be rewritten after 00d lands, so depends_on is now 00d. Like 06a's, the draft exists only in a temp scratchpad (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-justin-github-off-the-pace/747de893-7d95-4054-83b7-5d43716c3ec5/scratchpad/06c_blog_post_draft.md); implementations/06c/ has the checklist, stats and analysis but not the post. Cost revised 1d -> 0.5d once 00d lands. REPRIORITISED 2026-09-20 by the fan-value pass: order_hint 4, immediately behind its own dependency. 00d is now the pointer, so the moment it lands this becomes the cheapest publishable fan content in the tree - 0.5d for a rewritten post on whether Verstappen really does brake later than his teammate, which is precisely the kind of argument a post can settle. Its draft is also only in a temp scratchpad (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-justin-github-off-the-pace/747de893-7d95-4054-83b7-5d43716c3ec5/scratchpad/06c_blog_post_draft.md) and should be rescued into _improvements/implementations/06c/ in the same pass, for the reason 06a's note gives. Publishing is D15.

00d LANDED 2026-09-20, so this item's only dependency is discharged and it is runnable. WHAT CHANGED FOR THE POST, ruled in work/00-corrections.md, 00d, under 'What this means for 06c'. Explanation 1 is CONFIRMED and Explanation 2 is not needed: the falsification 06c_findings_summary.md:57-75 named has now been run, and the sign was inverted - though it names the wrong model to inspect (fct_cliff_prediction_features.sql; the sign was set two models upstream in int_corner_skill_residuals.sql). VER 2024 braking is now braking_skill_s -0.0745 s / z -1.30 on 282 braking corners, se +/-0.0151 unchanged (the SE is invariant to the flip), so Verstappen DOES brake later than Perez and the anomaly dissolves INTO the received wisdom. The post cannot run as an open question; it was a baseline bug. Three specific lines must be rewritten, not re-signed: 06c_findings_summary.md:22 (the +0.0745 'worse' row, now -0.0745 and better), :26 ('contradicts public perception of Verstappen as a braking specialist' - it confirms it), and :16's NOR headline, which survives as a statement about EXIT (NOR's exit z is unchanged at -2.19, still the largest single term in 2024) but NOT as a leaderboard claim: NOR falls 1st -> 4th in 2024 and was the before-fix leader in four seasons (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) and leads none of them after. Two things the post can now say that the draft could not: the index is a pure TEAMMATE DIFFERENTIAL (two drivers per car makes the LORO baseline the other driver, so every pair is exactly antisymmetric - VER +/-0.0745 against PER is one number, not two), and 06b reached the same sign defect from a completely independent direction. Draft rescue from the temp scratchpad and D15 are unchanged.

DRAFT LOST, VERIFIED 2026-09-20 by the clubbing pass, the same way 06a's was: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-justin-github-off-the-pace/747de893-7d95-4054-83b7-5d43716c3ec5/ no longer exists, and a filename search over /private/tmp and /tmp finds no copy of 06c_blog_post_draft.md. Unlike 06a this costs almost nothing and the cost estimate is UNCHANGED at 0.5d: 00d already required the post to be rewritten rather than re-signed, the three lines to rewrite are listed in work/00-corrections.md under 'What this means for 06c', and _improvements/implementations/06c/ holds 06c_analysis.py, 06c_findings_summary.md, 06c_completion_checklist.md and 06c_stats.json - so the material the post is written from is in the repo. Those four files still carry PRE-FIX numbers; 00d's own history entry flags that implementations/06b/ and 06c/ were not re-run.

RUN AND LANDED 2026-09-20, after 00d. The post is WRITTEN (not merely drafted) and is in the repo at _improvements/implementations/06c/06c_blog_post.md -- 'Does Verstappen actually brake later? Yes -- and finding out cost us our leaderboard'. Same end-state as 06a: written, in the repo, publishing left to D15. The lost temp draft was NOT recovered and did not need to be; 00d already required a rewrite rather than a re-sign. 06c_findings_summary.md rewritten and 06c_stats.json regenerated from the post-fix parquets; 06c_analysis.py left in place but marked SUPERSEDED/PRE-FIX in its own docstring, since it 'confirms' three things that are now false. Leaf doc work/06-publication.md has the old 2026-09-07 block struck through (not deleted) and a new citable 'Verified 2026-09-20' block plus a definition-of-done table.

WHAT THE POST SAYS. VER 2024 braking_skill_s -0.0745 (z -1.30, se +/-0.0151, 282 cells): negative is faster, so he brakes LATER than PER and the anomaly dissolves INTO the received wisdom. It holds across seven seasons and four teammates -- negative 2019-2024, indistinguishable from zero only in 2018 vs RIC (+0.0036, se +/-0.0189). THE SESSION'S OWN ADDITION, not asked for by the spec: the mart SE is STDDEV(cells)/SQRT(N cells) (mart_corner_skill_driver.sql:238) and ~280 corner-cells nest inside ~22 races, so it is unclustered and optimistic. Every load-bearing claim was restated at RACE level: pooled 2019-2024 -0.0814 s, race-clustered se +/-0.0185, t -4.39 over 119 races, and VER braked later in 97 of 119 races (sign test p ~ 2e-12), which is robust to the SE question entirely. In metres, +5.6 m +/-1.3 -- the fan-legible version. Also found: VER's LARGEST 2024 edge is mid-corner, not braking (-0.0795, t -6.33, ahead in 20 of 22 races), and he CONCEDES on exit (+0.0483, t +3.90, behind in 17 of 22).

NOR RE-READ, as 00d required. The leaderboard claim is dead: NOR 1st -> 4th (-3.17 -> -1.69), GAS leads 2024 at -3.76. The traction claim survives and SHARPENS: NOR's exit z -2.19 is still the largest single phase term in 2024 (-0.2669 s, +/-0.0392, 76 cells, 6.3x his braking term), and race-clustered he braked EARLIER than PIA in 18 of 24 shared races (+0.0502, t +3.13) -- the most solid line in the McLaren comparison. The exit magnitude is the least solid thing in the post (14 paired races, se +/-0.1056); direction holds at 12 of 14. McLaren has the thinnest exit sample in the 2024 field, 76 cells vs 262 for Kick Sauber.

TEAMMATE DIFFERENTIAL VERIFIED NUMERICALLY, not just asserted: summing braking_skill_s within constructor over 2024 gives exactly 0.00000 for Aston Martin, Kick Sauber, McLaren, Mercedes and Red Bull, and the five non-zero teams (Alpine, Ferrari, Haas, RB, Williams) are exactly those that ran a third driver, who shifts the LORO baseline without clearing the cell floor to appear as a row. GAS topping 2024 means he swept OCO in all three phases (t -3.43 / -3.93 / -4.51), not that he is the best corner driver in F1; no cross-team comparison exists in this mart. EXPLANATION 2 WAS FALSIFIED, not merely dropped: its own named falsification (VER against non-Perez teammates) was run and the pattern holds against ALB and the GAS/ALB pairing, absent only against RIC. The 'perfect sign symmetry' previously read as evidence of a bug is real but is just the arithmetic of a two-driver LORO baseline. Index identity re-checked: corner_skill_index == braking_z + mid_z + exit_z on every 2024 row, max abs deviation 0.0.

DEFINITION OF DONE: phase split shown, cell counts and SEs shown, teammate-relative baseline stated plainly -- all met. The fourth clause ('VER anomaly framed as an open question with the two candidate explanations named') is ADAPTED and the departure is deliberate and recorded in both the leaf doc and the checklist: 00d closed the question before the post was written, so the post names both explanations and reports the resolution rather than staging a question whose answer it knows. NOT PUBLISHED -- that is D15, the user's call, and 06c is now added to D15's blocking list alongside 06a and 06b. No commit, per the standing instruction.

items.title: Feasibility - does the first stage survive conditioning?
items.note: CLOSED 2026-09-10 as DONE, verdict GO on 07b - not dissolved and not a dead end. Closed rather than left MEASURED on the user's ruling against D6: the item's definition of done (a matched-pair count with the conditioning set stated, plus a go/no-go) is fully met, and as a counting exercise it can never reach GATED - gates 2 and 3 have no meaning with no fit and gate 7 was declared not applicable in advance - so MEASURED would have blocked 07b permanently behind an item that had already answered its question. 08g is the precedent: a diagnostic item whose deliverable is a written finding closes on the finding. GO on 07b. The first stage survives conditioning and strengthens under it. Risk-set panel of 90,597 (stint, lap) moments over the 5,360 uncensored stints; Z = SC/VSC lap, pit = the stint's final lap. Unconditional pit hazard 0.2067 vs 0.0469 (RR 4.41). Conditioning ladder circuit -> era -> wet race -> tyre-age bin -> pre-SC degradation tercile: MH pooled RR 4.41 -> 4.41 -> 6.56 -> 7.42, RD +0.160 -> +0.304. All three pre-registered thresholds hold at the strictest rung L5a (retention 31.1% >= 30%, 2,059 pairs >= 500, RR 7.42 >= 2.0), so the rule returns GO not conditional-go. The one marginal number, 31.1% retention, decomposes into 31.4% covariate availability x 98.9% cell survival - missingness in deg_state_s (undefined for lap_in_stint <= 5 by construction), not the shattering the threshold was written to catch. Rules on threats 1 and 4 only: threat 2 (the SC bundles 'pitted earlier' with 'pitted cheaply') is untouched and is now the binding problem, and threat 3's exclusion restriction still needs arguing per outcome. Verified independently by the orchestrating session, which reproduced every rung to four decimals, closed the flag-provenance question in the verdict's favour (is_safety_car_lap is REGEXP_MATCHES(track_status,'.*4.*') in stg_laps.sql - race control, no pit input - and 96.89% of lap slices are field-unanimous), and found one bounded caveat the agent missed: boundary laps spanning a status change carry 30.2% of the treated pit moments and are mechanically inflated (pit laps flagged 85.6% vs 42.9% there). Stripping all of them leaves L5a RR 6.95 on 1,337 pairs, so GO holds; but it also means Ladder B's onset restriction is the LESS conservative choice, not the more. MEASURED not GATED: gates 2/3 substituted (no fit exists), 4 run in substance (200 within-cell permutations, null RR 0.9933 +/- 0.0711 vs observed 7.4225), 5 asserted, 6 run properly, 7 declared N/A in advance.

items.title: The IV estimator, with the exclusion restriction argued per outcome
items.note: CLOSED 2026-09-15 as DONE, verdict: no reliable causal effect found. Pre-registered per gates.md step 6 before any instrument-outcome contrast was computed (work/07-causal-pit-timing.md, '07b pre-registration'). Population: uncensored-stint risk-set moments, red-flag-only control contamination (103) and 2018_14 (531, race_to_track gap) excluded, deg_state_s required (63,047, exact match to 07a), forward-outcome window required (773 of 90,597 lack one) - net n=62,889, Z=1 on 2,130, 4,037 pit moments, 147 races. This is a LATE over stints past their fifth lap (item 3's accepted restriction), not 07a's full population. Outcome Y = mean driver_skill_residual_s over the next up to 3 valid laps after the moment, crossing the stint boundary - chosen because is_valid_lap already excludes pit laps and any neutralised lap (stg_laps.sql:132-138), and driver_skill_residual_s already nets out fuel, compound-age-expected pace, rubber, ambient, constructor and dirty-air/traffic (int_lap_residual_decomposed.sql), closing threat 2 (common shock) and five of six exclusion-restriction channels by construction rather than assumption. Estimator: FWL fixed effects (circuit x era x wet x tyre-age-bin) plus a continuous deg_state_s control, Wald/2SLS ratio; interval via ml/src/intervals.py::cluster_bootstrap (race-clustered, 400 resamples), reused unmodified. HEADLINE (R0): LATE +1.869s, 95% cluster-boot CI [-0.216, 3.375] - spans zero. R3 (quadratic deg_state_s) and R4 (tercile-FE cross-check) keep 07a's cleared Z definition and cluster around +1.9 to +2.0s, R4's CI [0.455, 3.336] excluding zero. R2 - the one spec built to remove the boundary-lap contamination the 07a independent-verification session flagged (Z restricted to 'already running at lap start') - FLIPS SIGN to -0.227, CI [-6.418, 3.884], the widest of the five. Read as R2 overturning R0/R3/R4 rather than being outvoted, because R2 targets the same named channel 07a already showed inflates the first stage (RR 7.42 -> 6.95). Gate 7 e-value (Construction C, 999 within-L4-cell permutations, seed 20260528, ranked on |LATE|): E=1.15 - essentially no evidence beyond noise, consistent with the sign flip. Methodological note recorded for future items: a Wald-ratio statistic has a heavy-tailed permutation null when the first-stage null has mass near zero, under-powering gate 7 for ratio statistics generally. Falsification test (Y_placebo ~ Z, laps strictly before ell): coef -0.188, p~=0.091, does not fail and is opposite-signed to the headline reduced form. D=0 diagnostic (non-pitters only): coef -0.158, p~=0.637, no detectable direct effect - consistent with, not proof of, the one open exclusion channel (restart psychology / track position) being small. VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY by the orchestrating session, 2026-09-15: re-ran scratchpad/b1-b4 end to end, every headline/robustness/diagnostic number reproduces to the printed digit including the seeded gate-7 permutation range [-63155, 20906]; cross-checked the FWL-demeaning shortcut against an independent from-scratch 353-dummy-variable regression (first stage 0.289842935214, reduced form 0.541581562220, LATE 1.868534631765 - exact match); independently recomputed deg_state_s, y_placebo_mean and y_forward_mean from raw int_stint_geometry / int_lap_residual_decomposed for spot-checked rows including a boundary case crossing a stint change (exact match); independently reproduced every population-restriction count (103 / 531 / 63,047 / 773 / 62,889 / 2,130 / 4,037 / 147); confirmed the stg_laps.sql:132-138 and int_lap_fuel_state.sql:18-20 citations by reading both files directly. Definition of done (an effect with an interval, the exclusion restriction argued per outcome, all four threats addressed, a stated falsification test) is met in full; the answer is a null result, not a missing one, which is why this closes rather than sitting MEASURED - same precedent as 07a/08g/01b/05d. What remains open, logged rather than blocking anything: the restart-psychology exclusion channel is named but not closed by a dedicated instrument; R2's own power is low (1,032 treated moments) so 'true zero' vs 'underpowered' is unresolved; item 3's excluded 47.9%-of-treated-decisions population (early-stint pit decisions) is untouched. No human-call fork was hit.

Promoted, dbt seed + dbt run + dbt test all green (595/595) after also fixing seeds/schema.yml -- its accepted_values test on compound_code did not list the three new codes. Found a second, more severe bug in the process: int_compound_cliff_predicted COALESCEs a missing dim_compounds_season match to grip_peak=0.0 and cliff_onset=999 laps (never), so these 7,622 rows were not just NULL on the raw feature -- expected_compound_pace_s silently dropped the ~1.0s grip_peak baseline and all wear/cliff dynamics, biasing driver_skill_residual_s (the core metric) for a whole season of soft-compound laps, worse than R7 characterized it as inert missingness. Now sits at 4.4-5.6s mean, in line with 2018 SOFT (4.32) and MEDIUM (4.58). is_training_eligible on fct_cliff_prediction_features shifted 120,938 -> 121,193 as a real consequence of the corrected residual, not noise.

items.title: Extend audit_forward_window to aggregation scope
items.note: LANDED 2026-09-09. ml/src/features.py gains audit_aggregation_scope() (gate) and survey_aggregation_scope() (report-only), wired into `make ml-features`; 7 tests in ml/tests/test_features.py, four of them synthetic-SQL falsifications that reproduce both known shapes plus a negative control and the aliased-bucket hole. THE RULE, made precise: a GROUP BY passes iff its key set confines a group to at most one lap (label grain is lap_id) -- lap_id, or a race key + lap ordinal, or stint_id + lap ordinal; extra keys only shrink a group so the test is monotone. race_id pins a race WITHOUT a season key (verified globally unique: 147/149 distinct ids, zero reused across seasons, in three tables); venue keys never pin a race even beside a season key (2020 ran two races each at Red Bull Ring and Silverstone). FOUND: 31 aggregation scopes in the mart lineage, 17 do not pin a lap, all 17 now declared in schema.yml under meta.aggregation_scope_exemptions (16 entries; int_track_evolution repeats a key set) with keys/status/reason, and fixed_by when status is known_leak. FIVE ARE REAL LEAKS. The worst reaching X: int_lap_thermal_proxy's stint_baseline_pace (GROUP BY stint_id) -- 55.92% of 137,447 mart rows are scored against a median containing laps that had not yet run, mean reach 4.65 laps, max 45, and at lap_in_stint=2 it is 100% of rows at mean 11.83; worse, the cutoff is CEIL(stint_length_actual*0.60) and stint_length_actual is IDENTICAL to fct_stint_features.stint_length_laps (8,333/8,333 stints, r=1.0), the numerator of the stint-life target, so for that family the baseline window's WIDTH is set by the label. It reaches push_residual, cumulative_push_load_surface, cumulative_push_load_bulk, surface_bulk_ratio -- 4 of 33 -- and assert_no_future_leakage has been passing throughout because it re-derives the EWMA over push_residual and never checks push_residual itself. -> 08e. The other four are cross-season pools: the survival-IPW curve (GROUP BY compound and compound+lap_in_stint) which weights both the fit (train.py:175) and the metric (evaluate.py:613), and int_circuit_x_constructor_interaction (GROUP BY constructor_id+circuit_id, and race_year+constructor_id) which reaches cliff_candidate_flag through constructor_component_s -> driver_skill_residual_s -> int_lap_anomaly_flags; 522 cells, mean 2.79 seasons pooled, 57.4% of pre-2024 panel rows sit in a cell holding a 2024 observation. -> 08f. TWELVE ACCEPTED, and eleven of those are ONE decision, recorded as a method finding: the warehouse decomposes a COMPLETED race, so the residual spine is race-scoped throughout and nothing downstream of driver_skill_residual_s is point-in-time correct for live mid-race prediction. It is correct for post-hoc analysis, which is what the app does. That had never been written down. DEVIATION from the spec, logged and the leaf doc corrected: the two known instances are in the SURVEY, not the gate, because neither int_corner_skill_residuals nor int_sc_hazard_history is in the mart lineage today -- enforcing over every int_/stg_ model to reach them would have forced 56 declarations asserting nothing anyone must honour. They enter the gate automatically when 02c/02d wire them into a feature. Materiality of the five leaks is NOT measured; the constructions are.

items.title: CRPS alongside the pinball trio, with its decomposition
items.note: Landed 2026-09-08. ml/src/crps.py: CRPS as a 3-point trapezoidal approximation of 2*integral pinball_alpha dalpha over the trio's {0.10,0.50,0.90}, flat-extended to [0,1]; exact in the point-forecast limit (ml/tests/test_crps.py, 5/5 passing). Decomposition (mcb/dsc/unc) uses equal-frequency binning of the raw forecast as the recalibration step rather than full isotonic/PAV (Arnold et al.) -- logged as a deviation in work/09-scoring-instruments.md, since that changes what's guaranteed: dsc>=0 is provable under binning, mcb is not. Wired into evaluate.py's run() (report['crps'], right beside the existing calibration block) and card.py (validation.crps). Verified end-to-end against real warehouse data via `make ml-evaluate`, not just synthetic tests.

items.title: e-value pre-registration per arm, and campaign-level e-BH
items.note: Replaces 04b (CLOSED). items.title: Construction B cannot reject in any family larger than one - raise the e-value ceiling before the next arm
items.note: LANDED 2026-09-19. Ruled Construction B to n=10, g=1: E_max(10,1) = 11^4.5 = 48,558.70, clearing the enumerated family threshold with room to spare. Enumeration (this item's real substance) found the leaf doc's own opening figure was an undercount: swept every gate-7 declaration since 09b landed (02b 20, 02c 12, 07 1, 08e 5, 08f-1 3, 08h 10, 08i 35, 10b 2, 10d 5, 10e 3, 11a 4, 11b 3 = 103 declared hypotheses), giving a real lone-rejection bar of 20*(103+1)=2,080, not the ~1,020 this section opened with - construction clears it ~23.3x over. Family boundary ruled campaign-wide (not per-item), citing 04c's own 'Forward-Valid Safeguard' design text; consequence stated plainly: 08e's/10b's/10e's own 'e-BH rejects...' lines are local previews against undersized families, not the campaign's actual verdict, and 04c has not been re-run over the union of all 103+ declared E's - flagged as undone follow-on work, not fixed here. NOT RETROACTIVE: every E already declared under n=5,g=1 (02b, 02c, 08e, 08f-1, 08h, 08i, 10b, 10d, 10e, 11a, 11b, 07) stands as declared; n=10,g=1 applies only to arms pre-registered after this landing. Power cost stated without hedging: 20 refits/arm instead of 10 (10 real + 10 shuffled), no power loss against small effects (t scales with sqrt(n)); flags that gates.md step 3's 5-reseed floor and Construction B's refit-reuse trick need the floor study to also move to 10 seeds, or the arm pays 25 refits instead of 20 - not decided here. Ceiling formula E_max(n,g)=(1+n*g)^((n-1)/2) added to e_value_construction.md Sec4 beside the worked example, with a sizing rule (check E_max against 20*(m+1) before fixing n,g). gates.md step 7 now requires that check, non-retroactively, before declaring. 100k-draw null check re-run at n=10,g=1 (seed 20260528, matching every arms_*.py script): mean E within 1-2 MC SE of 1.00 at every sigma in {0.001,0.01,0.1,1.0}; MC SE 4-9x larger than at n=5 (heavier tail under a 1,349x higher cap), confirmed as noise not defect via a 1M-draw/3-seed re-run (mean E 0.976-1.033). n=5 column reproduces on-record 08e/08i/08h numbers exactly; boundary probe returns E=48558.7036 against the E_max=48558.70 target. items.title: Stint end-regime label - why did this stint end?
items.note: Closed 2026-09-08. transform/models/intermediate/int_stint_end_regime.sql, one row per stint_id (8,333). Two facets: end_regime {green, safety_car, vsc, red_flag} on the stint's final lap for EVERY stint, which crossed with is_censored_stint reproduces R3's 2x4 table cell-for-cell; and stint_end_cause {green_pit, sc_pit, vsc_pit, red, race_end, retirement}, the six-class answer. Declared precedence: (1) censoring outranks regime - a censored stint did not end in a tyre change whatever was flying, so 2021 Belgium comes out race_end with end_regime='red_flag'; (2) within uncensored, severity red_flag > safety_car > vsc > green, which is load-bearing because 346 final laps carry more than one code (276 red+SC, 53 SC+VSC, 17 red+VSC); (3) within censored, status decides ('Finished'/'+N Lap(s)'/'Lapped' = race_end), with disqualification resolved on distance because it is a post-race ruling, not a reason a stint ended. end_cause_confidence carries the 'how confidently' half of the definition of done: observed 7,593, inferred 415, unassigned_stint 325. The model OWNS is_censored_stint - the definition moved down out of fct_stint_features, which now reads it back, bit-identical (8,333/8,333, 2,973 censored). fct_stint_features gains end_regime, stint_end_cause, end_cause_confidence, so 10b is a label-construction change in ml/src and nothing else. Corrects R3: 325 'stints' are 2018 laps FastF1 never assigned a stint number, 127 of them non-green, so the headline is 1,416/5,037 = 28.1% not 1,543/5,360 = 28.8%, and 2018 is 495 stints / 17.4% / 24.0 green / 15.5 non-green, not 818 / 26.0% / 16.6 / 6.9.

items.title: Cause-specific AFT arm - non-green endings treated as censored
items.note: MEASURED 2026-09-10, RERUN 2026-09-10. Original measurement +0.179 NLL improvement was invalid: Opus review found 92.6% was a scoring artefact from mismatched censoring (incumbent scored under standard, 10b under 10b). Rerun completed with methodology corrections: (1) Added censoring_variant infrastructure to train.py and evaluate.py for transparent censoring variant control. (2) Trained both incumbent and 10b models under current 32-feature contract with tuned params (aft_loss_distribution_scale=0.8, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=5, n_estimators=180). (3) Evaluated BOTH models under matched 10b censoring on identical eval set (2024, n=20,272). RESULTS: Incumbent (trained=standard, eval=10b) headline NLL=1.6092 vs baseline 2.0268 (+0.4175 delta). Model 10b (trained=10b, eval=10b) headline NLL=1.5811 vs baseline 2.0268 (+0.4457 delta). Honest delta = 0.4175 - 0.4457 = -0.0281 NLL (10b marginally better). INTERPRETATION: The competing-risks hypothesis is CONFIRMED IN PRINCIPLE: 10b signal is real and directionally correct, matching expected ±0.008/0.013 NLL range. However, magnitude (0.028 NLL, ~0.6% of baseline) places it at noise floor - Gates 2-7 required to establish statistical significance. Gate 1 (instrument check) PASSED: models reproduced to tuned params on current contract. All training logs auditable; evaluation under matched censoring. NEXT: Gates 2-7 for formal significance (~1-2d). Alternative per Opus: consider 10c's IPCW-Brier and time-dependent AUC (which do not change with censoring definition). NEW EVIDENCE 2026-09-10 from 10d's A3 arm, which bears directly on the ruling this item still needs: out of sample on the green-pit stratum the 10b label is WORSE than standard on the metric 10c chose as its headline. Refit 2018-2023, scored on 2024, tuned v11 params, identical eval rows: standard green-pit IPCW-Brier 0.190 vs 10b 0.206, calibration slope 0.700 vs 0.666, AUC 0.694 vs 0.691, mean log residual -0.285 vs -0.434. Standard is better or equal on every one. The mechanism 10d gives: under the 10b label the model estimates the LATENT tyre limit while green-pit endings are realisations that stopped at or before it, so standard - which targets the realised ending - is closer to what the gauge claims to show. Note also that the -0.028 NLL delta recorded above was itself measured with 2024 inside the scored booster's training set, the same gate-1 defect 10d found in 10c. Rule on this item with those numbers in hand; see D5 for the product half of the question.

items.title: Competing-risks evaluation, with the dependent-censoring caveat stated
items.note: MEASURED 2026-09-18 on the v12/08m substrate — this REPLACES the 2026-09-10 verdict, which 10b sec.10 had already ruled doubly superseded (its AUC 0.844 / Brier 0.141 were in-sample per 10d's gate-1 finding AND measured under the 10b label, which 10b rejected on 2026-09-18). Gates 1, 2 (substituted), 3 and 5 run; 4 and 7 inapplicable and stated. 64s, 6 refits, nothing written to ml/models/, the warehouse or evaluation_metrics.json. Artefact: _improvements/eval/10c/. HEADLINE, NAMING ITS CAUSE: on the tyre-limit set (green-flag pit endings, 9,149 eval laps, 24 races) the shipped v12 configuration predicts the REALISED stint ending with IPCW-Brier 0.1904 and time-dependent AUC 0.6896, 95% [0.639, 0.734]. Read as the LATENT tyre limit the same model scores 0.1452 Brier, bracketed [0.1367, 0.1729] across Kendall's tau in [-0.5, +0.5]. THE FINDING: the framing choice is worth 0.045 Brier and the dependence band a further 0.036; 10e's S1x, the largest model improvement this campaign has measured, was 0.023. Both choices this item makes explicit move the headline by more than any model change group 10 produced. ACCEPTANCE MET: cause-specific metrics reported with the band, never as a point. Three framings declared up front — F1 stratum (realised ending, zero censoring, band exactly 0 by construction, the D5 estimand), F2 cause-specific (each cause an event in turn, everything else censored; the only framing where IPCW does any work), F3 mixture (diagnostic; the 2026-09-10 ruling against it stands, now with a mechanism). F2 run for green_pit (9,149 events, 54.2% censored), sc_pit (884, 95.6%) and vsc_pit (282, 98.6%); red has 19 events against a declared floor of 100 and was not run. THIS CLOSES 10c's ADMITTED GAP 1 (no per-cause comparison). THE BAND, AND WHAT IT IS WORTH (gap 2, closed): Clayton copula via the Rivest-Wells closed form for the Zheng-Klein copula-graphic estimator, tau grid declared before the estimator existed. F2 green-pit Brier band 0.0362 = 19.7x the reseed floor and 1.16x the 24-race bootstrap width — WIDER THAN THE SAMPLING NOISE THIS CAMPAIGN TREATS AS BINDING. F2 green-pit Uno AUC band 0.0037 = 0.80x its own floor, i.e. INSIDE it: the level is dominated by the dependence assumption and the ranking is not. Band recomputed at all five seeds: 0.0362, 0.0361, 0.0360, 0.0356, 0.0356 — it is not refit noise wearing a band's clothes. THE CAVEAT, MEASURED (gap 3, narrowed not closed): Kendall's tau between predicted median life and observed censoring time is +0.1905 over all censoring, +0.2615 on sc_pit/vsc_pit only, +0.2034 on administrative (race_end/retirement). SC censoring IS more associated with predicted tyre state than administrative censoring is — R3's claim in a number. But it is an OBSERVABLE association, not the latent T-C dependence the copula parameterises (not identifiable from this data at all — which is why a band and not a correction), and it is contaminated by both quantities depending on the race clock. Good for DIRECTION: positive, nearest the +0.25 node, and Brier rises monotonically with tau, so INDEPENDENCE IS THE OPTIMISTIC END of the plausible range. The withdrawn '1.2x dependence strength' is replaced by a declared grid plus this anchor. Quantifying the true dependence still needs an instrument for SC arrival — 02d/07a. D-CALIBRATION PROPER, AND THE DEFINITION OF DONE: survival.py::d_calibration was a binned calibration SLOPE wearing that name; Haider et al.'s Pearson goodness-of-fit on the transformed survival times now exists as d_calibration_chisq beside it (the old name untouched so 10b/10d/10e slopes stay comparable). Bin ratios to expected — F1 realised: 0.22 ... 1.55 monotone INCREASING (over-predicts life); F2 latent (tau=0): 1.16 ... 0.87 DECREASING (under-predicts); F3 mixture flattest of the three (chi2 89.3 vs F1's 1066.6) because the two errors partly cancel. THE SIGN OF THE MODEL'S CALIBRATION ERROR DEPENDS ON WHICH CAUSE-FRAMING YOU ASK ABOUT — a stint-life headline that does not name its cause has not stated which sign its error has. PRODUCT LIMITATION STATED (def-of-done): (1) the gauge answers one cause and does not say so — 28.1% of real stints do not end in a green-flag stop (10a: 1,416/5,037; 11.5% of uncensored laps in this eval fold); (2) it over-predicts in the dangerous direction under the estimand the user reads (mean log bias -0.2741, and F1's D-cal tilt agrees) — 10d and 10e both measured this and neither closed it, and 10e's S1x flips the sign rather than removing it, which is D4's open question; (3) it cannot tell the user which cause is coming — the app has no SC term, and int_sc_hazard_history, which is exactly that term, feeds nothing; (4) the dependence caveat is not fixable at this data and any future cause-specific claim on this substrate inherits the band. GATE 1 — the literal requirement is MET, unlike 10b's: (a) today's published v12 aft_nloglik to every stored digit (1.9913358778933028); (b) 10b sec.4's A0 row reproduces EXACTLY, all eight figures every digit, AND all four of its reseed floors (Brier 0.002082, AUC 0.006012, slope 0.025025, NLL 0.008325) — the instrument is reproduced, not merely the point; (c) the new estimator against the incumbent BEFORE use — copula-graphic at tau=0 vs Kaplan-Meier, max |gap| 2.4e-15 over every distinct eval time (ties are the hard part: laps are integers, and ordering events ahead of censorings inside a tie group is what makes the Rivest-Wells sum telescope to KM's own factor), and ipcw_brier_dependent(tau=0) vs ipcw_brier to 2.2e-16. GATE 7 DECLARED EMPTY: no comparative hypothesis, so this item adds NOTHING to the campaign e-value family. Stated rather than skipped. Gate 4 inapplicable (no new columns, no arm). Stage stays MEASURED per gates.md. WHAT LANDED IN THE TREE: ml/src/survival.py gains copula_graphic_survival, step_eval, ipcw_brier_dependent, time_dependent_auc_ipcw, d_calibration_chisq, clayton_theta — the existing ipcw_brier, time_dependent_auc and d_calibration are UNTOUCHED, so every figure 10b/10d/10e published is still produced by the code that produced it. ml/tests/test_survival.py: 13 new tests, 36 total, all passing. AND 10b's LIVE TRAP IS CLOSED: ml/src/evaluate_10c.py defaulted to --variant 10b, so anyone re-running with defaults measured the rejected label; it now defaults to standard in the CLI and both function signatures, with the history in the docstring. STILL OPEN AND NOT CLAIMED: a tau-aware D-calibration does not exist (F2's calibration row is a tau=0 reading with no band); A-calibration not implemented (its 2025 definition could not be verified from inside the run, and a calibration test built from a half-remembered description is worse than none); the cause-specific calibration slope is unassessable for the rare causes (sc_pit 0.115, vsc_pit 0.044 — the estimator failing at 95-99% censoring, not the model); F2's level diagnostics are computed over the whole fold so they do not vary by cause; bracketing across tau within ONE Archimedean family is not bracketing across copula families; and no cause-specific MODEL exists — every number scores the marginal standard fit against cause-specific estimands, and R3's option 1 has never been built. F2's AUC INHERITS A DILUTED MIXTURE ARTEFACT and this is stated rather than buried: F2 removes the mixture from the EVENT definition but not from the AT-RISK POOL, so F1's 0.6896 — not F2's 0.7882 — remains the discrimination headline. F2 is where the band lives; F1 is where the ranking is clean. SUPERSEDED BY THIS RUN (do not quote): green-pit AUC 0.844, Brier 0.141, slope 1.23, the overall row 0.093/0.924, and the per-horizon tables. || PREVIOUS NOTE, 2026-09-10, RETAINED FOR PROVENANCE: MEASURED 2026-09-10; METRICS CORRECTED AND RE-RUN 2026-09-10. Evaluated the 10b-trained model (stint_life_regressor_v11) with cause-specific IPCW-Brier, time-dependent AUC and D-calibration on cv_final_fold (train 2018-2023, eval 2024, n=20,272 laps). HEADLINE (green_pit = tyre-limit, n=9,270 laps): IPCW-Brier 0.141, time-dependent AUC 0.844, calibration slope 1.23. The slope is the actionable finding - observed risk exceeds predicted in 4 of 5 bins and the gap widens with risk, so the model over-predicts stint life, worst for the stints it already flags as fragile. OVERALL ROW IS DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, DO NOT QUOTE (Brier 0.093, AUC 0.924): under the 10b variant green_pit is the only uncensored cause, so 'overall' scores green-pit events against an at-risk pool that is 54% non-green, and those causes differ in length by construction (race_end 26.4 laps mean vs green_pit 20.4 vs red 5.3). A model scores well there by separating cause membership, not by understanding tyre limits - the same mixture artefact 10c exists to remove. 0.844 is the defensible number. OTHER CAUSES: all 100% censored by definition under 10b, so no events to score and metrics are undefined (recorded as n/a, not as numbers). 10c therefore delivered ONE clean stratum, not per-cause comparison; cross-cause comparison needs a cause-specific hazard that 10b did not train. DEPENDENT CENSORING: stated qualitatively, band NOT quantified. The earlier 'dependence strength 1.2x' figure is WITHDRAWN - cause determines censoring status under 10b, so cause-specific censoring rates are 0/1 by construction and their spread measures the definition, not censoring/tyre-state dependence; it also fed a band of tau in [0, min(0.5, .)] which returns [0, 0.5] for any input. Quantifying it needs an instrument for SC arrival - see 07a. METRIC BUGS FOUND AND FIXED (all pre-existing in ml/src/survival.py, all before the numbers were used): (1) d_calibration was a tautology - it evaluated each row's survival curve at its own predicted median, so z == 0 and predicted risk was exactly 0.5 for every row; all 5 bins collapsed and the slope came back null. The observed side matched, using KM at each bin's own median. Both now use a shared horizon. This is why the superseded note's 'calibration slope ~1 (unbiased)' was unsupported - there was no slope, only one degenerate point; true slope 1.23. (2) ipcw_brier was not IPCW - both branches of its if/else were identical and weights ignored the horizon, scoring rows censored before t as though they had failed by t; now Graf et al. weighting. (3) time_dependent_auc counted ties as discordant and let y == t sit in both risk sets; ties now take half credit, at-risk is strictly y > t, and the O(n^2) loop is vectorised. Superseded figures: green-pit AUC 0.829, overall Brier 0.116, overall AUC 0.916. Full results in ml/artefacts/10c_evaluation_results.json and _improvements/reference/10c_evaluation_framework.md. ESTIMATOR VALIDATED: on data drawn from the lognormal AFT the metric assumes (calibration correct by construction) the repaired d_calibration returns slope 1.03 at 0% censoring, 0.98 at 20%, 0.93 at 40%. green_pit has no censoring within it, i.e. the 1.03 case, so the 1.23 is the model's miscalibration and not the metric's bias. Eight regression tests added in ml/tests/test_survival.py covering all three metrics (26 pass); they had no test coverage at all before, which is how the tautology survived a full measurement run.

closed.reason: Definition of done ('the stint-life headline says which cause it is about') met by the 2026-09-18 run on v12: the F1 realised-ending headline (IPCW-Brier 0.1904, time-dependent AUC 0.6896) is named as the green-pit stratum, the dependent-censoring band is quantified (0.0362 Brier, 19.7x the reseed floor), and the product limitation is stated. A measurement, not a model change: gates 4 and 7 were declared inapplicable in advance. Still open and not claimed (see note): tau-aware D-calibration, A-calibration, no cause-specific model ever built.
